title: ficus diversifolia var. deltoidea
intro: Ficus diversifolia var. deltoidea, commonly known as the Philippine Banyan, is a species of fig tree native to the Philippines. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Ficus diversifolia var. deltoidea include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and anti-diabetic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits and therapeutic actions.
